title: First Letter to Appear Twice
summary: For a string s made of lowercase English letters, identify the first character that repeats.
statement: For a string s made of lowercase English letters, identify the first character that repeats. Ensure the second instance of this character precedes any other character's second instance. Confirm the string includes at least one character that repeats.
constraints: The lowercase string contains at least one repeated letter.
Return the letter whose second occurrence appears earliest.
Scan order, not alphabetic order, determines the answer.
hints: Maintain a set of letters already visited.
Read the string from left to right.
Return immediately when the current letter is already in the set; otherwise add it.
The first membership hit is precisely the earliest second occurrence by scan order.
editorial: The first membership hit is precisely the earliest second occurrence by scan order.

tests.explanation: The second c is the earliest second occurrence.
The final d is the first character encountered for a second time.
